hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Calculate the total weight of each word by summing weights of its constituent characters.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Use the character offset relative to lowercase a to retrieve letter weights from the weight mapping.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Sort words by their total weight ascending, breaking ties in standard lexicographical order.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Weights are computed in linear time with respect to the total length of all words, then sorted in O(n log n).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: A brute force approach would exceed time limits by redundantly reprocessing states.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Balances linear traversal with auxiliary tracking structures.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects an optimal linear or logarithmic solution with edge-case handling.
